title: Semantic Engineering: An AI-led SDLC Methodology
description: Semantic Engineering is a methodology for AI-led software delivery developed at Accion Labs. It models an enterprise application as a four-layer knowledge graph (functional, design, architecture, and code) that AI agents query for precise, governed context, addressing the "Manual Translation Tax" of feeding tacit enterprise knowledge to coding agents. This repository contains the full methodology site, covering the AI-assisted SDLC track and the legacy-modernization track, the agent fleet, the operating model, and case archetypes.
